article.headline: Jessamy scores 16, Tennessee State defeats Western Illinois 72-52
article.description: — Ron Jessamy scored 16 points as Tennessee State beat Western Illinois 72-52 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Jessamy scores 16, Tennessee State defeats Western Illinois 72-52
article.story: MACOMB, Ill. -- — Ron Jessamy scored 16 points as Tennessee State beat Western Illinois 72-52 on Saturday night. Jessamy added eight rebounds and five blocks for the Tigers (6-11, 2-4 Ohio Valley Conference). Josh Ogundele scored 12 points while finishing 5 of 7 from the floor and added eight rebounds. Julius Rollins led the Leathernecks (8-9, 2-4) in scoring, finishing with 18 points and two steals. Marko Maletic added 13 points for Western Illinois. NEXT UP Both teams play again on Thursday. Tennessee State hosts SIU-Edwardsville and Western Illinois travels to play Morehead State. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
